title: Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations: The Therapeutic Closing Charge Agreement
content:
**Business office guidance — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations.** The **therapeutic closing charge** is the private bed-hold charge on the therapeutic closing entry: the closing entry of a released Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold that carries more than one resident-private entry — the resident-private entry with the latest last day on the reservation, when it is not also the opening entry. The resident or representative signs the private bed-hold charge agreement for it, and the signed charge is what posts.

### When the charge is fixed and posted

The therapeutic closing charge is fixed only after the opening entry of the leave carries its bed-hold charge.

The therapeutic closing charge is not posted until the resident-private entry of every earlier private-pay hospital leave of the resident that carried a single resident-private entry carries its own bed-hold charge.

Put in the terms the records use: the therapeutic closing charge is fixed only once the reservation's ledger shows a bed-hold charge naming the opening entry of the leave, and it is not posted while any earlier private-pay hospital leave of the resident that carried a single resident-private entry shows that entry without its own bed-hold charge.

### What signing does

Signing posts the bed-hold charge: the charge is recorded on the reservation's ledger, dated the day it is posted, naming the held-days entry it prices and the number of held days it bills, and the reservation's bed-hold balance rises by the amount. The signer sees the posted charge and its reference number on the receipt.

### Invocation

`sign_therapeutic_closing_charge_194aeb06` is the resident's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the resident or the representative — runs it to sign.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bedhold_reservation_id` | the reference number of the bed-hold reservation the charge belongs to, as given by the business office from the reservation record | text reference |
| `days_entry_id` | the reference number of the booked resident-private held-days entry being charged, as given by the business office from the reservation's ledger | text reference |
| `day_count` | the number of held days the charge bills, the figure stated by the business office; it is recorded as the charge's day count | a whole number of at least 1, in days |
| `amount` | the bed-hold charge, the figure stated by the business office | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded half up to the cent |

No parameter takes an enumerated value.

### Return

A one-line text receipt: "Signed therapeutic closing charge <charge reference> on reservation <reservation reference> for held-days entry <entry reference>: <days> days, <amount> USD posted <posting date>; bed-hold balance now <balance> USD." The references echo those given, the days are a whole number, the amount and the balance (the reservation's bed-hold balance including the charge) are in USD with two decimals, and the posting date is in year-month-day form. A receipt in this form means the charge is posted.

Errors: a `day_count` that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused with an error and nothing is posted; an `amount` that is not greater than zero is refused with an error and nothing is posted.
